run.question: Search VictoriaLogs for ERROR level log messages from the 'payment-api-257' service in the 'app-257' namespace. What error codes (format VLERR-XXXX) appear in those logs?

report.summary: VictoriaLogs holds exactly one stream, {namespace="app-257",service="payment-api-257"}, and it matched only 7 log entries in the whole authorized window, all ingested at 2026-11-23T16:31:10Z (level counts: ERROR 3, INFO 3, WARN 1). The three ERROR entries carry the codes VLERR-7291 (database connection timeout: failed to connect to primary database after 30s), VLERR-4058 (payment validation failed: invalid card number format) and VLERR-9463 (stock sync failed: external inventory API returned 503). A case-sensitive detail worth stating: the field filter level:error (lowercase) returned no entries, while level:ERROR returned those 3 rows, so the stored value is uppercase ERROR and the lowercase query simply did not match the stored value. No other VLERR-style codes and no other ERROR entries were returned in the 30-day window; the question only asked which codes appear, and that is confirmed for the returned rows.
